en.headline: FEHD opens disciplinary probe after officers filmed smoking in uniform
en.dek: A viral video showed two men from a district hawker control task force lighting cigarettes in a back alley; the department said the incident dated to early June and that smoking in uniform is strictly banned.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Monday evening it had opened a disciplinary investigation after a video circulated online showing two of its officers smoking while in uniform.

A department spokesman confirmed the men belonged to one of its district hawker control task forces and that the footage was recorded in early June. Staff are prohibited from smoking in uniform or in public spaces under departmental rules.

The department said it attaches great importance to staff discipline and professional conduct and that any breach will be followed up strictly. The Department of Health separately noted that lighting up in a statutory no-smoking area is an offence under the Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance carrying a fixed penalty of HK$3,000.

zh.headline: 食環署人員着制服街上吸煙 署方確認展開紀律調查
zh.dek: 網上片段顯示兩名小販管理隊人員在後巷吸煙，食環署證實事件發生於6月初，強調着制服及在公眾地方吸煙一律禁止。
body: 食物環境衞生署周一晚上確認，已就網上流傳兩名人員着制服吸煙的片段展開紀律調查。
發言人表示，片段中男子屬該署其中一支分區小販管理隊，事件發生於6月初。按照部門規定，員工不得在穿着制服或於公眾地方吸煙。
署方強調重視員工紀律及專業操守，任何違反規定的行為會嚴肅跟進。衞生署亦指出，在法定禁煙區吸煙屬《吸煙（公眾衞生）條例》罪行，可處定額罰款3,000元。
